common:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one high-fidelity raster design proposal for the Goal Hint predictions HOME PAGE, as a wide landscape presentation board approximately 2400x1450. Input image 1 is the CURRENT desktop homepage structural reference; input image 2 is the CURRENT mobile homepage structural reference. They are references, not content to paste unchanged. Show desktop on the LEFT taking 73% of width, and the mobile screen on the RIGHT taking 24% of width, aligned at the top with comfortable narrow gutter. Flat front-facing UI, clean screenshot-style rendering, no physical monitor or phone frame, no photography, no perspective. One design direction per image. Both screens must use the SAME design and sample content.
Top outside the UI: small restrained label "DESIGN {NUMBER} · {TITLE}", with "Goal Hint · Home page proposal · Illustrative data" underneath. A pale neutral surrounding board and a very small bottom note "Design proposal only". Keep enough resolution for crisp readable typography.

PRESERVE the current information architecture and compact density. Desktop: navy brand bar with the existing teal football Goal Hint logo and white wordmark; Predictions active followed by Live, Results, Slip builder, Help, More and theme icon. Heading "Today's Matches", right-aligned Today / Next 3 days / Next 7 days / Next 30 days. Search "Team or league" and square teal Search button. One compact full-width filter section with date and time controls on first row, Leagues / Countries / Markets / Odds / Probability on second row. Then small applied filter summary at left and Sort by / Earliest first / Clear / Apply on right. "Predicted Matches", "Showing 1–8 of 228 matches". Dense full-width table with navy heading row: # / Date & Time / League / Home team / Score / Away team / Market / Prediction / Probability / Result / detail chevron. Eight compact rows. Very narrow pagination at bottom.
Mobile: copy the current compact structure: navy Goal Hint brand bar with theme icon, search with square Search action, horizontal day strip showing Tue-Oct 13, Wed-Oct 14 SELECTED, Thu-Oct 15 with arrows and Calendar square, then Earliest first / Clear / Filters row, "Showing (228 matches)" small right-aligned. Seven compact SQUARE ticket rows visible. Each row has a slim league-and-kickoff metadata strip, HOME and AWAY on TWO stacked lines with small crests/flags, plus a slim RIGHT pick stub with dashed vertical divider; stub shows 1X2, bold pick and probability or "No pick / Not predicted". Fixed navy bottom nav Matches / Live / Results / More, Matches active teal.

SAME ILLUSTRATIVE SAMPLE DATA for all proposals, date Wed, Oct 14:

5. Friendlies Women, 02:00 EAT, USA W / Spain W, Match result, 2, 61%, Pending
6. Friendlies Women, 02:30 EAT, Brazil W / Argentina W, Match result, 1, 70%, Pending
7. Primera A, 02:30 EAT, Bucaramanga / Águilas Doradas, Match result, 1, 64%, Pending
8. CONCACAF Caribbean, 03:00 EAT, Portmore United / Violette AC, Match result, 2, 59%, Pending.
Score column shows vs, current unavailable state is demonstrated by row 3. Predictive values are fictional illustrative layout data.

Base brand: Manrope-like clean sans typography, navy #102A3A, teal #007F7A, page #CEDBE3, white surfaces, text #102A3A, muted #486071, subtle borders #C5D4DE. Match result semantic emerald #00824A with pale #DBF9E7. All controls, tabs, cards, badges and frame corners SQUARE: zero radius. Quiet fine rules, strong alignment, careful spacing, compact but legible. No hero, no sidebar, no stats/KPI tiles, no ads, no large empty margin, no new features, no consent pop-up, no Next.js developer overlays, no exaggerated shadows, no decorative textures. Do not reproduce the old GoalPredict brand.

directions.title: Refined Original
directions.direction: Closest to the current application: keep its pale blue-gray page, navy header and white surfaces. Improve typographic alignment, reduce noisy border contrast, use 1px rules and slight teal highlights. Retain desktop original two-row filters and mobile two-line team tickets. Elegant precise polish with minimal structural change.

directions.title: Crisp White
directions.direction: Use a near-white #F8FAFC page with crisp white table and filters, navy brand and table bars unchanged. Restrained light gray alternating rows, subtle cool borders and emerald pick badges. Mobile has white tickets on near-white background and a darker top bar. The distinctive change is a bright elegant white workspace.

directions.title: Teal Precision
directions.direction: Keep the original pale blue-gray page. Use slender precise teal 1px top rules on filters and table, thin teal outline for selected date cell and teal action area. Navy table heading is solid flat. Right mobile prediction stub uses an extremely pale teal tint, bold emerald pick, tiny straight probability meter. Analytical polished compact layout.

directions.title: Editorial Navy
directions.direction: Preserve structure. Give the page disciplined editorial typography: medium compact title, strongest dark navy team labels, quiet gray meta text and generous clear baselines within dense rows. Use white surfaces and pale blue-gray page. Slightly taller slim navy table heading with small uppercase labels. Mobile card meta strip in pale slate, bold dark navy stacked teams, outlined white prediction stub. No serif or magazine hero.

directions.title: Soft Slate
directions.direction: Use muted cool slate #E7EDF1 page and white surfaces, #CBD5DC fine borders, softened light gray card metadata strips. Deep navy brand bar. Reduce visual saturation in controls and rows, keeping teal primary actions and emerald pick semantic accents. Slightly smaller square badges and quieter alternating table rows. Mobile slate background separates white ticket cards.

directions.title: Compact Ledger
directions.direction: The most compact professional variation: desktop rows slightly shorter around 36px, tabular numerical columns, dates on one line where possible, thin horizontal grid rules, small 1X2 and pick cells, solid navy header. Use original palette. On mobile tickets around 74px high, two aligned team lines and precise fixed-width prediction stub, 5px gaps. Keep text readable and no missing filters. Strong ledger-like alignment.

directions.title: Quiet Prediction
directions.direction: Preserve original layout and density. Prediction emphasis uses white square chips with a slim emerald LEFT rule and bold navy pick digits; slim emerald straight probability bar paired with readable percent. Reduce colored fills, pastel emerald Market labels remain. Mobile prediction stub white with a subtle emerald 2px top rule, clear 1X2 / pick / probability vertical hierarchy. Clean restrained color with prominent prediction values.

directions.title: Framed Workspace
directions.direction: Keep existing sequence but visually unite desktop search, full filter controls, summaries, count and table within ONE square white workspace panel on pale blue-gray page. Fine horizontal dividers separate sections, no rounded nesting. Brand bar and page heading remain outside. Mobile has one unified white feed surface with thin dividers between compact ticket rows, maintaining two stacked team names and slim dashed prediction stub. Distinct by unified grouping, not new architecture.

directions.title: Delicate Teal Wash
directions.direction: An elegant very pale teal page #EDF6F4 and almost-white filter surface, white table rows, deep navy branding. Selected day cell uses a subtle pale teal fill with square thin teal outline. Fine desaturated teal separators. Mobile right stubs use barely visible mint tints; emerald picks and teal actions. Keep all treatments very light and avoid gradients.

directions.title: Evening Charcoal
directions.direction: Use existing dark theme as the only dark variation: page #141C22, surfaces #1E2932, brand/table bar #101820, primary text #F1F5F7, muted #A3B4BF, borders #35434C, teal accents #53D5C6. Flat charcoal, subtle alternating row fills, no glow. Predictions use muted emerald square badges and pale mint readable text. Mobile same compact ticket format, darker slim meta strips and dark prediction stub. Elegant calm dark palette, full desktop controls preserved.
